_doc: How tools/audio.py drives the sound engine. RAM names come from ram.inc. The game requests music with wMusicTrackToPlay (PlayMusic) and sound effects through hJingle / hWaveSfx / hNoiseSfx, which the main loop copies into wJingleToPlay / wWaveSfxToPlay / wNoiseSfxToPlay; here the requests go straight into those bytes. UpdateSound runs once a frame from the VBlank handler: the effect engine of bank $1F, then the music engines of banks $1B (tracks $01-$10, $31-$40) and $1E (tracks $11-$30, $41-$60). Both music banks share the channel records wMusicChannel1-4 at $D310.

music.label: Music
music._playing: the song number inside its bank's table; 0 when a song without a loop ends

music_channels._doc: per channel: its RAM record, the offset of the pattern pointer (the note just played is the byte before it), the pattern list pointer, and the flag byte/bit set while a sound effect owns the channel

pokes._doc: the item fanfares $0F, $10 and $25 start hLastMusicTrack again when they end; $FF stops the music instead
